sources.utron: sim/utron_profile.py spec of sim/pole_design_variants_op.json 'g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm'

rotor.item: hub (vessel, AH, PEEK retainer, gel, G10 coupler)
La / Lb chokes (first cut, tau 0.5 s)
electronics: Z1 / Z4, D1-D4, CW chains, D1*-D4*, snubbers, bypass, wiring, potting

counter_rotor.item: inner bearing spiders (4, G10 8 mm, r 26-162)

sf_750.item: utron stack as a beam (bond, normal to the laminations)
... the same with the stud preload (stack never decompresses)
A4-70 M6 studs, shear at the stack's end faces
studs as beams, NO bond or preload credit (yield)
G10 cheek, net tension at the stud holes
G10 cheek, bearing at the stud holes
A4-70 M5 cheek-root bolt, shear (assumed fastening)
G10 carrier disc, shear-out at its rim
G10 carrier disc, ring tension + bending
G10 bridge ring, hoop + bending + self
Al vanes, sector roots and rings
Al Ca / Cb plates, hoop at the bore

assumed.root_bolt: 1 x A4-70 M5 per cheek root, reamed hole, preload 3.5 kN

magnetic.note: per side, all three utrons aligned at once (A at rotor angle 0, B at 30 deg); the pull pulses at the 120 Hz pump frequency, A and B in antiphase

thermal.note: uniform +20 K (ground at 20 C, run at the record's 40 C ambient), the utron core +6 K over it (46 C coils), cheek +4, disc +2; the counter-rotor +1 K (bridge iron 0.1 W each); worst: G10 in-plane alpha 16e-6 on the rotor, 10e-6 on the counter-rotor, sleeve +10e-6 through the thickness

criteria.no_rub: g_min >= 0.25 mm (half the gap) at 750 rpm, hot, worst-case stack-up [IR]
criteria.eccentricity: eccentricity at the gap <= 10 % of g [RH: a common rule for machine air gaps]

vane stacks: face friction (22 gaps).how: Daily & Nece regime III at the relative speed (Re 1.88e+05, G 0.040, c_M 0.0066); x 0.72 counter-rotation and x 0.367 metal coverage (nominal / low), full discs (high)

vane stacks: sector edges (144 sectors).how: c_D 0.4 on the 3 mm full-round edge pair at w r against air with no mean rotation; 0.1 (the windows' air half entrained) to 0.8

Ca / Cb stacks: outer plate vs the Ca|re.how: Daily & Nece regime IV, s 12 mm, r 50-150, relative speed

Ca / Cb stacks: rims vs the cage (2).how: Taylor-Couette r 150, gap 12 mm, 48 mm long (Re 1.5e+04); grooves k 1.5 (1-2.5)

reluctance sections: salient utrons in t.how: paddle model (c_D 2, ring c_f 0.005: core rotation K 0.71); cross-check Taylor-Couette r 130, gap 1.08 mm, L 156 mm: 2.39 W smooth (k 1-2.5)

counter-rotor outside in still air: cage.how: Theodorsen & Regier, cage r 166 x 564 mm (Re 1.15e+05, c_f 0.0043) + bridge rings r 156.5 x 2 x 174 mm; +-30 %

bridge-ring ends vs the frame's end spid.how: Daily & Nece, annulus r 131.5-156.5, s 6 mm

hub coupler in the counter-rotor's cavit.how: cylinder r 33 x 144 mm at the relative speed

balancing.note: ISO 21940-11: the permissible mass-centre offset = G / omega, U_per = that offset x m, split equally between two correction planes of a symmetric body [OC: the standard's definitions; IR: the grade]
